title: A finitely presented flat module is finite projective
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $A$-module which is finitely presented (there is an exact sequence $A^{\oplus m}\to A^{\oplus n}\to M\to0$ for some $m,n\ge0$; in particular $M$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]) and flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $M$ is a projective $A$-module; hence $M$ is a finite projective $A$-module.
